h1: The 7 Best Leaf Blowers of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 7 leaf blowers across gas backpack, gas handheld and cordless battery, compared on listed CFM, format and price tier.
summary: The Milwaukee M18 FUEL is our top all-round pick for most yards. The Echo 1110 CFM backpack is for acreage, the DEWALT 60V is the strongest battery option, and the MZK is the cheapest way to clear a small yard.
intro: The key choice with a leaf blower is power source, not brand. A gas backpack and a cordless handheld solve different problems, and buying the wrong type is the costliest mistake.
We reviewed seven blowers from the listings across gas and battery formats, and ranked them on listed CFM, format and price tier.

products.name: Milwaukee M18 FUEL 120 MPH 450 CFM 18-Volt Lithium Ion Brushless Blower
products.verdict: Strong airflow with no gas to mix.
products.description:
The Milwaukee M18 FUEL lists 120 MPH, 450 CFM and a brushless 18 volt motor in a handheld format, in the $100-200 tier.

It leads because most yards need this much air without the weight and maintenance of gas. Its limit is that gas backpacks list far higher CFM.

It suits average home yards. The caveat is battery runtime.

products.name: DEWALT 60V MAX Axial Handheld Blower DCBL772B
products.description:
The DEWALT DCBL772B lists 600 CFM in a 60V handheld format, in the $100-200 tier.

It ranks second because it moves more air than the Milwaukee but needs the 60V battery system.

It suits big yards. The caveat is the platform buy-in.

products.name: Husqvarna 150BT Gas Leaf Blower
products.description:
The Husqvarna 150BT lists 765 CFM in a gas backpack format, in the $200-500 tier.

It ranks third because gas gives more power but needs fuel and upkeep.

It suits large lots. The caveat is noise and maintenance.

products.name: Echo 220 MPH 1110 CFM 79.9 cc Gas 2-Stroke X Series Backpack Blower
products.verdict: 1110 CFM for acreage and pro work.
products.description:
The Echo X Series lists 220 MPH, 1110 CFM and a 79.9 cc 2-stroke engine in a backpack, in the $500+ tier.

It ranks fourth because it is the strongest here but also the priciest.

It suits acreage and landscaping. The caveat is cost and weight.

products.name: Husqvarna 125B Gas Leaf Blower
products.description:
The Husqvarna 125B lists 470 CFM in a gas handheld, in the $200-500 tier.

It ranks fifth because it gives similar airflow to the Milwaukee but costs more and needs fuel.

It suits those who prefer gas. The caveat is upkeep.

products.name: MZK 20V Cordless Leaf Blower
products.verdict: 450 CFM in the lowest price tier.
products.description:
MZK lists 450 CFM on a 20V battery, in the $25-50 tier.

It ranks sixth because it matches the Milwaukee on listed CFM for far less but lacks its platform.

It suits small yards. The caveat is the unproven brand.

products.name: DEWALT 20V MAX Blower
products.verdict: A compact 100 CFM blower for light clean-up.
products.description:
The DEWALT 20V MAX lists 100 CFM in a cordless format, in the $100-200 tier.

It ranks last because its airflow is the lowest here.

It suits light patio work. The caveat is the airflow.

methodology.title: Format fit
methodology.description: Backpack, handheld and cordless were judged on the yards they suit.

methodology.title: Power source
methodology.description: Gas and battery tradeoffs were weighed.

whatMatters.detail: CFM is the volume of air per minute. More CFM clears leaves faster. Look for the number in the title and compare similar formats.
Gas gives more power for big jobs but needs fuel and upkeep. Battery is quiet and clean but limited by runtime. Check the power source in the title.
Handhelds suit short jobs, backpacks spread weight for long ones. Match format to session length.
MPH helps lift wet leaves. Look for both CFM and MPH.
A known brand or battery platform eases parts and batteries. Check warranty on the listing.

faq.a: Attach the nozzle and fuel or charge the battery.
Clear the intake, and for gas use fresh fuel mix.

finalTake: The Milwaukee M18 FUEL is our top pick for most yards. DEWALT 60V is the strongest battery, Echo is the acreage pick, and MZK is the budget buy. Pick power source first.
